item.title: Georgia strengthens Career Pathways to support students and state economy - AllOnGeorgia
item.description: Georgia is modernizing how career pathways are organized in schools, transitioning from 17 Career Clusters to 14 Career Clusters aligned with today’s workforce needs. Students will continue to have access to all 152 state-approved CTAE pathways, now organized to better reflect growing industries and make career exploration easier for students and families.
